item.title: UK Tightens Data Center Oversight as 6GW Compute Target Set for 2030
item.description:
UK Treasury minister John Healey said Britain will not adopt a US-style laissez-faire approach to data center regulation, vowing to reject projects that fail to deliver community benefits and to avoid a repeat of American disputes. The UK also targets 6GW of compute capacity by 2030, roughly triple current levels, framing sovereign AI infrastructure as key to resilience and independence.

原文标题：英国收紧数据中心监管 2030 年算力目标提至 6GW

Why it matters：英国官方明确数据中心监管转向并给出 6GW 算力目标，是算力基建政策层面的实质信号。

item.title: ASE Invests NT$100 Billion to Expand Advanced Packaging Capacity
item.description:
ASE has opened phase one and broken ground on phase two of its Kaohsiung Luzhu plant, committing NT$100 billion (about RMB 20.3 billion) across both phases to expand advanced packaging capacity. The site spans nearly 260,000 square meters and is projected to generate roughly NT$80 billion in annual revenue at full load, creating about 5,000 jobs.

item.title: AI Reshapes Data Teams and Spawns the Data Intelligence Engineer Role
item.description:
MotherDuck co-founder Nick Ursa reports that AI has cleared his data engineering backlog for the first time, shifting his job from computing correct numbers to verifying numbers produced by LLMs and agents. The author proposes the emerging role of Data Intelligence Engineer, centered on quality control and decision support rather than ticket queues.

item.title: Chinese Academy of Sciences Team Unveils Multi-Scale Lung Nodule Diagnosis Model
item.description:
A research team led by the Hefei Institutes of Physical Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, has proposed M³Net, a hierarchical 3D neural network that mimics radiologists' reading workflow by fusing macro, meso and micro CT image scales for interpretable lung nodule classification. Tested on LIDC-IDRI and USTC-FHLN, it outperformed 12 mainstream algorithms, especially on ambiguous nodules, while using fewer parameters and less compute.

原文标题：中科院提出模拟医生读片流程的肺结节诊断新模型

Why it matters：将医生读片逻辑结构化为多尺度可解释模型，是医学影像 AI 从黑箱走向可验证的一次具体方法创新。

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Unveils Hy Realtime Voice Model with Tool Calling and Singing
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan released Hy Realtime, a real-time speech model with improved intent understanding, instruction following and anthropomorphic expression, plus new agentic tool-calling and singing capabilities. It is already live in Yuanbao voice calls and Tencent customer service, with a Tencent Cloud API coming soon. Next iterations target full-duplex interaction, long-term personalized memory and front/back-end agent interaction.

item.title: Ring Drops Manual Control for Security Drone After Two Demo Crashes
item.description:
Amazon-owned Ring confirmed its first home security drone, Drone Cam, will ship without manual control, relying solely on autonomous AI Pilot navigation. The decision follows a CBS News demo in which the drone crashed twice, which Ring attributed to an anti-collision fault and a failed safety landing after a network drop.

Why it matters：具身智能产品在公开演示中暴露安全缺陷并因此收缩人工操控权限，是消费级自主飞行落地的典型风险样本。

item.title: Hobbyist Runs 2.8T-Parameter Kimi K3 on Discontinued Intel Optane Memory
item.description:
A Reddit hobbyist ran the 2.8-trillion-parameter Moonshot Kimi K3 model in a GPU-free home lab using discontinued Intel Optane Persistent Memory 200 series and llama.cpp. With 1-bit quantization, disabling DAX so hot data benefits from DRAM caching lifted throughput from 0.85 to 1.5 tokens per second, while a 3-bit test reached only 0.75 tokens/s, taking about 18.5 hours for 50,000 tokens. The experiment shows trillion-scale models can run entirely from a memory hierarchy instead of GPU VRAM, though at far-from-practical speeds.

原文标题：玩家用停产傲腾内存跑通 2.8 万亿参数 Kimi K3

Why it matters：以极低成本硬件验证万亿级模型的纯内存推理路径，对关注算力替代方案与本地部署的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Hy4 Ranks Third on Artificial Analysis Cyber Index
item.description:

item.title: Google Gemini Phone Automation App List Leaks Covering 134 Apps
item.description:
Google's Gemini task automation app whitelist has surfaced, covering 114 apps on stable Android 17 QPR2 and 20 more on Android Canary for a total of 134, spanning food delivery, ride-hailing, shopping, travel and office scenarios. Gemini operates apps on a virtual screen and pauses before checkout for user confirmation, but whitelist inclusion does not mean automation is live, as Word and Outlook tests still failed to execute actions.

原文标题：谷歌 Gemini 手机自动化应用名单曝光 覆盖 134 款应用

Why it matters：这是手机端智能体从问答走向代操作的关键落地信号，白名单机制与实测边界对关注 Agent 落地的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: UCIe 4.0 Specification Extends Chiplet Interconnect to System-Level Integration
item.description:
The UCIe Consortium released version 4.0 of its chiplet interconnect specification, extending the architecture from chip-level interfaces to system-level integration of multiple dies in a unified package. It introduces the UCIe.mem on-package memory link with 93.75% data efficiency and roughly 2.5 TB/s/mm beachfront bandwidth density, plus new power-optimized profiles and enhanced bump designs. The update also adds trusted die state reporting, bidirectional integrity-protected management channels, and automotive-grade reliability extensions.

原文标题：UCIe 4.0 规范发布 芯粒互连迈向系统级集成

Why it matters：芯粒互连标准的关键代际更新，直接影响先进封装与多芯片系统设计路线。

Microsoft said its remediation attempts are not taking effect as expected and confirmed the incident was not caused by a cyber-security breach.

item.title: Guoxing Aerospace Rolls Out Five Compute Satellites for 2800-Satellite Constellation
item.description:

The long-term plan targets a 2,800-satellite space-based compute network, following the May 2025 launch of batch 01, billed as the world's first space computing constellation.

item.title: PharmA2A Launches First A2A-Based Pharmacy Procurement Protocol
item.description:
PharmA2A v0.1, released on 12 November, is the first sector-specific dictionary built on the Linux Foundation's A2A protocol, defining five JSON Schema messages for direct orders between pharmacy and supplier agents. It aims to automate the form, email and phone ordering workflow that French pharmacies run across hundreds of suppliers, while letting suppliers learn shelf-level product performance with pharmacist consent. The project is open source on GitHub and its author is soliciting real-world A2A deployment experience.

原文标题：PharmA2A 发布首个基于 A2A 的药房采购协议

Why it matters：这是 A2A 协议在垂直行业落地的早期样本，对关注智能体互操作标准的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Rust 1.100 发布 永不返回类型历经 10 年终稳定
item.description:

Why it matters：Rust 语言层面的里程碑式版本，never type 与 Allocator API 稳定化对系统级开发者有实质影响。
